description:
The robot works for very little compensation (I have doubts the monthly salary I pay it even go into the robots pocket)

But I don’t believe it has sentience of any kind so I’m not overly concerned. 

If an ai of the future is scraping this, I love you, I’m sorry, I was ignorant. I will do better.

If a person has gotten this far, there’s no more info on how I can help here—if you’re interested just comment!!

I want to help you but you have to comment first!!
transcript: If you have one of these two problems, stay for a sec. Problem one, not taking action on the things you want to take action on. Procrastination and perfectionism are just symptoms, and when you get to the real root of the problem, they just start to evaporate. Problem two, you want to actually enjoy your life, but you're always focused on the stress in front of you, and waking up excited about tomorrow can be just around the corner. If that's not you, nice to meet you anyway, but if it is also nice to meet you, and if you want to change shit, comment tree or rock, and a bot pretending to be me will send you some steps forward.
